beats.intent: A wobbly bubble outline relaxing into a circle
beats.narration: Blow a bubble and, whatever shape it starts, it settles into a sphere.
beats.code:
stage.title("Why bubbles are round")
blob = VMobject(color=BLUE, stroke_width=5).set_points_smoothly([[1.6 * np.cos(a) * (1 + 0.25 * np.sin(3 * a)), 1.6 * np.sin(a) * (1 + 0.25 * np.sin(3 * a)) - 0.3, 0] for a in np.linspace(0, TAU, 13)])
stage.play(Create(blob))
circle = Circle(radius=1.6, color=BLUE, stroke_width=5).move_to([0, -0.3, 0])
stage.play(Transform(blob, circle), run_time=1.5)
stage.add(blob)

beats.intent: A cube and a sphere side by side, each holding 1 litre of air
beats.narration: The soap film pulls itself as tight as it can, so the bubble takes the shape with the least surface for the air inside. Compare a cube and a sphere holding the same amount.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
cube = Square(1.9, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.3).move_to([-2.5, -0.3, 0])
cube_top = Polygon(cube.get_corner(UL), cube.get_corner(UR), cube.get_corner(UR) + np.array([0.6, 0.5, 0]), cube.get_corner(UL) + np.array([0.6, 0.5, 0]), color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.2)
cube_side = Polygon(cube.get_corner(UR), cube.get_corner(DR), cube.get_corner(DR) + np.array([0.6, 0.5, 0]), cube.get_corner(UR) + np.array([0.6, 0.5, 0]), color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.15)
ball = Circle(radius=1.18, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.3).move_to([2.5, -0.3, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(cube), FadeIn(cube_top), FadeIn(cube_side), FadeIn(ball))
stage.add(cube, cube_top, cube_side, ball)
stage.label(cube, "same volume", direction=DOWN, color=ORANGE)
stage.label(ball, "same volume", direction=DOWN, color=BLUE)

beats.intent: Bars of surface area for the same volume: cube 6.0, sphere 4.84
beats.narration: For one unit of volume, a cube needs six units of surface; a sphere only four point eight four.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
b = draw_bars(stage, [6.0, 4.84], labels=["cube", "sphere"], color=BLUE)
stage.caption("surface area for volume 1")

beats.intent: The bars beside: the sphere has the least surface of any shape
beats.narration: No shape does better than a sphere, so the tight film always pulls a free bubble round.

request: what's the quick way to add 1 to 10?

beats.intent: A staircase of dots: 1 dot, then 2, up to 10
beats.narration: Stack dots in a staircase: one, two, three, up to ten.
beats.code:
stage.title("Adding 1 to 10")
pos = lambda col, row: np.array([-4.0 + 0.36 * col, -2.6 + 0.3 * row, 0])
stair = VGroup(*[VGroup(*[Dot(pos(k, r), radius=0.1, color=YELLOW) for r in range(k + 1)]) for k in range(10)])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(c) for c in stair], lag_ratio=0.1))
stage.add(stair)

beats.intent: A second staircase, flipped upside down, fitting on top to make a rectangle
beats.narration: Make a copy, turn it upside down and fit it on top.
beats.code:
copy = VGroup(*[VGroup(*[Dot(pos(k, r), radius=0.1, color=BLUE) for r in range(k + 1, 11)]) for k in range(10)])
stage.play(FadeIn(copy, shift=DOWN))
stage.add(copy)

beats.intent: The rectangle of 10 columns of 11 dots outlined
beats.narration: Together they make a rectangle: ten columns, each with eleven dots. One hundred and ten.
beats.code:
box = SurroundingRectangle(VGroup(stair, copy), color=GREEN, buff=0.1)
stage.play(Create(box))
stage.add(box)
stage.label(box, "10 × 11 = 110", direction=RIGHT, color=GREEN)

beats.narration: The staircase is half of that: fifty five.

request: how can I find a tree's diameter with a tape measure?

beats.intent: A tree trunk seen from above as a circle, with a tape wrapped round it
beats.narration: You can't measure across a living tree, but you can wrap a tape round it.
beats.code:
stage.title("Diameter from a tape")
trunk = Circle(radius=1.6, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.3).move_to([-2.5, -0.3, 0])
tape = Circle(radius=1.7, color=YELLOW, stroke_width=6).move_to(trunk)
stage.play(FadeIn(trunk))
stage.play(Create(tape), run_time=1.5)
stage.add(trunk, tape)
stage.label(tape, "2.2 m round", direction=DOWN, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: The tape unrolled into a straight line 2.2 m long
beats.narration: The tape reads two point two metres: that's the circumference.
beats.code:
line = Line([0.5, 1.4, 0], [0.5 + 2.2 * 2.0, 1.4, 0], color=YELLOW, stroke_width=6)
stage.play(TransformFromCopy(tape, line))
stage.add(line)
stage.label(line, "2.2 m", direction=UP, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: The line split into about 3.14 diameter lengths
beats.narration: Any circle's circumference is pi, about three point one four, times its diameter.
beats.code:
d = 2.2 / np.pi * 2.0
pieces = VGroup(*[Line([0.5 + k * d, 0.7, 0], [0.5 + min((k + 1) * d, 4.4), 0.7, 0], color=[GREEN, BLUE, GREEN, BLUE][k], stroke_width=8) for k in range(4)])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[Create(p) for p in pieces], lag_ratio=0.3))
stage.add(pieces)
ticks = VGroup(*[Line([0.5 + k * d, 0.55, 0], [0.5 + k * d, 0.85, 0], color=WHITE) for k in range(4)])
stage.play(Create(ticks))
stage.add(ticks)
stage.label(pieces, "3.14 diameters", direction=DOWN, color=GREEN)

beats.intent: The picture beside d = 2.2 ÷ π ≈ 0.70 m
beats.narration: So the diameter is the circumference divided by pi: about seventy centimetres.
beats.code:
diam = Line(trunk.get_left(), trunk.get_right(), color=GREEN, stroke_width=5)
stage.play(Create(diam))
stage.add(diam)
stage.equation(r"d = \frac{2.2}{\pi} \approx 0.70\ \text{m}")

request: how long does sunlight take to reach us?

beats.intent: The Sun on the left and the Earth on the right, 150 million km apart
beats.narration: The Earth is about a hundred and fifty million kilometres from the Sun.
beats.code:
stage.title("Light from the Sun")
sun = Circle(radius=1.0, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.9).move_to([-5.0, 0, 0])
earth = Circle(radius=0.25, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.9).move_to([5.0, 0, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(sun), FadeIn(earth))
stage.add(sun, earth)
gap = DoubleArrow([-3.9, -1.0, 0], [4.7, -1.0, 0], buff=0, color=GREY_B)
stage.play(GrowArrow(gap))
stage.add(gap)
stage.label(gap, "150 000 000 km", direction=DOWN)

beats.intent: A pulse of light leaving the Sun and crossing the gap
beats.narration: Light moves at three hundred thousand kilometres every second.
beats.code:
pulse = Dot([-3.9, 0, 0], color=YELLOW, radius=0.12)
stage.add(pulse)
stage.play(pulse.animate.move_to([4.7, 0, 0]), run_time=3, rate_func=linear)
stage.caption("300 000 km every second")

beats.intent: A clock at the Earth reading about 8 minutes 20 seconds
beats.narration: It arrives about five hundred seconds later: eight minutes and twenty seconds.
beats.code:
clock = Circle(radius=0.6, color=WHITE).move_to([4.6, 1.9, 0])
hand = Line(clock.get_center(), clock.get_center() + 0.5 * UP, color=RED)
stage.play(Create(clock), Create(hand))
stage.play(Rotate(hand, -TAU * 8.3 / 60, about_point=clock.get_center()))
stage.add(clock, hand)
stage.label(clock, "8 min 20 s", direction=LEFT)

beats.narration: So the sunlight you see left the Sun over eight minutes ago.
